name: famulor
label: Famulor AI - Voice Agent
description: AI-powered calling and SMS platform. Automate outbound campaigns, manage leads, and get real-time call analytics.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Create an API key in your Famulor account and paste the value here. Get API key here -> https://app.famulor.de.

add_lead.label: Add Lead to Campaign
add_lead.description: Add a lead to an outbound campaign to be called by an AI assistant.

phone_number.label: Customer Phone Number
phone_number.description: Enter the phone number of the customer (E.164 format: +1234567890)

variables.label: Variables
variables.description: Variables to pass to the assistant

allow_duplicate.label: Allow Duplicates
allow_duplicate.description: Allow the same phone number to be added to the campaign more than once

num_secondary_contacts.label: Number of Secondary Contacts
num_secondary_contacts.description: How many secondary contacts do you want to add? (Max: 10)

secondary_contacts.label: Secondary Contacts
secondary_contacts.description: Add secondary contacts for this lead, as an object with contact_1_phone, contact_1_variables, contact_2_phone and so on.

list_leads.label: List Leads
list_leads.description: List all leads in your account.
list_leads.afterResponse: return { leads: Array.isArray(response) ? response : response && Array.isArray(response.leads) ? response.leads : [] };

list_phone_numbers.label: List Phone Numbers
list_phone_numbers.description: List all phone numbers linked to your account.

search_available_phone_numbers.label: Search Available Phone Numbers
search_available_phone_numbers.description: Search for phone numbers available to purchase.

country_code.label: Country code
country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to search in (supported regions per Famulor docs).

contains.label: Contains (digits)
contains.description: Optional. Only return numbers that contain these digits (numeric only, max 10 digits).

purchase_phone_number.label: Purchase Phone Number
purchase_phone_number.description: Purchase a phone number from the available search results.

phone_number.label: Phone number
phone_number.description: Exact E.164 value from Search Available Phone Numbers. Requires a payment method on file; creates a monthly subscription. (E.164 format: +1234567890)

send_sms.label: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS message using one of your purchased phone numbers.

from.label: From Phone Number
from.description: Select an SMS-capable phone number to send from

to.label: Recipient Phone Number
to.description: Enter the recipient's phone number (E.164 format: +1234567890)

message.label: Message
message.description: SMS message content (max 300 characters). Long messages may be split into multiple segments.

create_campaign.label: Create Campaign
create_campaign.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign.

name.label: Campaign name
name.description: Name of the outbound campaign (max 255 characters)

assistant_id.label: Assistant
assistant_id.description: Select the AI assistant to use for the call

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin, America/New_York). Leave empty for account default.

max_calls_in_parallel.label: Max calls in parallel
max_calls_in_parallel.description: 1–10 simultaneous calls (your plan may limit further)

allowed_days.label: Allowed weekdays
allowed_days.description: Leave empty to use API default (all days). Otherwise restrict to selected days, as a list such as ["monday", "friday"].

retry_on_voicemail.label: Retry on voicemail
retry_on_voicemail.description: Retry when the call reaches voicemail

retry_on_goal_incomplete.label: Retry on goal incomplete
retry_on_goal_incomplete.description: Retry when the call goal was not completed

goal_completion_variable.label: Goal completion variable
goal_completion_variable.description: Name of a boolean variable from the assistant post-call schema (max 255 characters)

mark_complete_when_no_leads.label: Mark complete when no leads
mark_complete_when_no_leads.description: Mark the campaign complete when there are no leads left to call

phone_number_ids.label: Outbound phone numbers
phone_number_ids.description: Optional. Caller IDs for this campaign (distinct phone number IDs), as a list such as [12, 13].

campaign_control.label: Start/Stop Campaign
campaign_control.description: Start or stop an outbound calling campaign.

action.label: Action
action.description: Select the action to perform on the campaign

make_phone_call.label: Make Phone Call
make_phone_call.description: Initiate an AI-powered phone call to a customer.

assistant_id.label: Assistant
assistant_id.description: Select the AI assistant to use for the call

phone_number.label: Customer Phone Number
phone_number.description: Enter the phone number to call (E.164 format: +1234567890)

variables.label: Variables
variables.description: Variables to pass to the assistant during the call

update_lead.label: Update Lead

campaign.label: Campaign
campaign.description: Optionally assign the lead to a different campaign

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: New phone number in E.164 format (leave empty to keep unchanged) (E.164 format: +1234567890)

status.label: Status
status.description: Lead status: created, completed, or reached-max-retries (leave unselected to keep unchanged)

variables.label: Variables
variables.description: Custom fields merged with existing lead variables (leave empty to skip)

delete_lead.label: Delete Lead
delete_lead.description: Permanently delete a lead and abort any ongoing calls.

get_current_user.label: Get User Information
get_current_user.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile and account balance.

generate_ai_reply.label: Generate AI Reply
generate_ai_reply.description: Generate an AI reply from an assistant for a given customer.

assistant_id.label: Assistant
assistant_id.description: Select the assistant to generate a response with

customer_identifier.label: Customer Identifier
customer_identifier.description: A unique identifier for the customer (e.g., phone number, email, CRM contact ID). Maximum length: 255 characters.

message.label: Message
message.description: The customer's message to respond to

variables.label: Variables
variables.description: Optional context variables to pass to the assistant

generate_ai_reply.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.success !== true) throw new Error('Failed to generate AI reply: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

create_conversation.label: Create Conversation
create_conversation.description: Start a new chat conversation with an AI assistant.

assistant_id.label: Assistant UUID
assistant_id.description: The UUID of the assistant to start the conversation with

variables.label: Variables
variables.description: Custom variables to pass to the assistant

create_conversation.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.status !== true) throw new Error('Failed to create conversation: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

get_conversation.label: Get Conversation
get_conversation.description: Retrieve the full message history for a conversation.

uuid.label: Conversation UUID
uuid.description: The unique UUID identifier of the conversation to retrieve

get_conversation.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.status !== true) throw new Error('Failed to get conversation: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

send_message.label: Send Message
send_message.description: Send a message to an existing conversation and receive the assistant's reply.

uuid.label: Conversation UUID
uuid.description: The unique UUID identifier of the conversation

message.label: Message
message.description: User message to send (max 2000 characters). The assistant's reply is returned in the action output field `message`.

send_message.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.status !== true) throw new Error('Failed to send message: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

get_whats_app_senders.label: Get WhatsApp Senders
get_whats_app_senders.description: List WhatsApp Business senders linked to your account.

status.label: Status filter
status.description: Online only (default API behavior) or all senders including offline. Use sender `id` as sender_id when sending WhatsApp messages.

get_whats_app_templates.label: Get WhatsApp Templates
get_whats_app_templates.description: List approved WhatsApp message templates for a sender.

sender_id.label: Sender
sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender numeric ID from Get WhatsApp Senders (the sender `id` field)

status.label: Template approval status
status.description: Approved templates only (default API behavior) or all templates including pending/rejected

send_whats_app_template.label: Send WhatsApp Template Message
send_whats_app_template.description: Send an approved WhatsApp template message via a Famulor sender.

sender_id.label: Sender
sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders

template_id.label: Template
template_id.description: Template ID from Get WhatsApp Templates (must be approved)

recipient_name.label: Recipient name
recipient_name.description: Optional. Used for conversation tracking and CRM (max 255 characters)

variables.label: Template variables
variables.description: Key-value pairs: use "1", "2", … or names from the template `variables` array. Leave empty if the template has no placeholders.

send_whats_app_template.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.success !== true) throw new Error('Failed to send WhatsApp template message: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

send_whats_app_freeform.label: Send WhatsApp Freeform Message
send_whats_app_freeform.description: Send a free-text WhatsApp message within an active 24-hour session.

sender_id.label: Sender
sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders (sender must be online)

message.label: Message
message.description: Free-text content (max 4096 characters). Only works within an active 24-hour messaging window; otherwise send a template first.

send_whats_app_freeform.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.success !== true) throw new Error('Failed to send WhatsApp freeform message: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

get_whats_app_session_status.label: Get WhatsApp Session Status
get_whats_app_session_status.description: Check if a 24-hour WhatsApp messaging session is active for a sender and recipient.

sender_id.label: Sender
sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders

recipient_phone.label: Recipient phone
recipient_phone.description: Recipient to check the 24-hour window for (E.164 format: +1234567890)

get_whats_app_session_status.afterResponse:
if (!response || response.success !== true) throw new Error('Failed to get WhatsApp session status: ' + ((response && (response.error || response.error_code)) || 'Unknown error'));
return response;

list_conversations.label: List Conversations

assistant_id.label: Assistant
assistant_id.description: Filter by assistant (must belong to your account)

whatsapp_sender_phone.label: WhatsApp sender phone
whatsapp_sender_phone.description: Filter by WhatsApp Business sender number (exact match)

per_page.label: Per page
per_page.description: Page size (1–100). Default on the API is 15 if omitted.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor (paste next_cursor from a previous list response)

list_conversations.beforeRequest:
Object.keys(request.query).forEach(function (k) { var v = String(request.query[k]).trim(); if (v) request.query[k] = v; else delete request.query[k]; });
return request;

list_calls.label: List Calls

per_page.label: Per page
per_page.description: Results per page (1–100). API default is 15.

list_calls.beforeRequest:
Object.keys(request.query).forEach(function (k) { var v = String(request.query[k]).trim(); if (v) request.query[k] = v; else delete request.query[k]; });
return request;

get_call.label: Get Call
get_call.description: Retrieve details for a call by ID, including transcript and recording.

call_id.label: Call ID
call_id.description: Numeric ID of the call (from list calls or Famulor UI)

delete_call.label: Delete Call
delete_call.description: Permanently delete a call record including its transcript and recording.

call_id.label: Call ID
call_id.description: Numeric ID of the call to delete permanently (transcript, recording, and metadata are removed)

delete_call.afterResponse: return response == null || response === '' ? { message: 'Call deleted' } : response;

phoneCallEnded.label: Phone Call Completed
phoneCallEnded.description: Triggers when a phone call completes.

assistant_id.label: Assistant
assistant_id.description: Select an assistant to receive post-call webhook notifications for

conversationEnded.label: Conversation Ended
conversationEnded.description: Triggers when a chat conversation ends.

assistant_id.label: Assistant
assistant_id.description: Select the assistant whose chat conversations (WhatsApp or web widget) should send this webhook when a conversation ends

inboundCall.label: Inbound Call Received
inboundCall.description: Triggers when an inbound call is received by your AI assistant.

assistant_id.label: Inbound Assistant
assistant_id.description: Select an inbound assistant to receive webhook notifications for

getAssistants.label: New or Updated Assistant
getAssistants.description: Triggers when AI assistants are created or updated in your Famulor account.

per_page.label: Items Per Page
per_page.description: Number of assistants to fetch per page (1-100, default: 10)
